identity: A form draft editor with section tabs, question cards, an editing pane, and controls for question content, routing, order, validation, and response policies.

scenarios.name: addq
scenarios.screen: The Questions tab shows the first of three sections, with three existing question cards and an Add question button below them. The first question is selected, its properties and validation controls are filled with the existing values, and no picker is open.
never: A newly added question already appears in the first section.
All nine existing question cards appear in one section.

arrangements.text: The section tabs run above two columns; the current section’s question cards and Add question button are on the left, and the selected question’s controls are on the right.
The section tabs run above a wider question column on the left and a narrower control column on the right.

scenarios.name: branching
scenarios.screen: The Questions tab shows the first section’s three existing question cards, including a multiple-choice question with three answer options. The first question is selected in the properties pane; no routing rules or destination picker are open.
never: The answer-routing pane is visible on load.

arrangements.text: The section tabs sit above the current section’s question cards on the left and the selected question’s controls on the right.
The section tabs sit above a narrow question column on the left and a wider control column on the right.

scenarios.name: reorder
scenarios.screen: The Questions tab shows three section tabs in their original order and three question cards in the first section in their original order. The first card is selected, its controls are visible, and the drag lists are closed.
never: The sections already appear in the requested reversed order.
Section and question drag lists are visible on load.
A question card sits between sections or outside its section.

arrangements.text: The section tabs run above two columns, with the first section’s question cards on the left and the selected question’s controls on the right.
The section tabs run above a wider question column on the left and a narrower control column on the right.

scenarios.name: validation
scenarios.screen: The Questions tab shows the first section’s three existing question cards, with the first question selected. Its properties pane shows Response validation set to None and Required off; the rule picker is closed and no minimum or maximum fields are shown.
never: A number range or text length is already filled in.
Minimum and maximum fields appear while the selected rule is None.
The validation rule picker is open.

arrangements.text: The section tabs sit above the current section’s question cards on the left and the selected question’s properties and validation controls on the right.
The section tabs sit above a narrow question column on the left and a wider column for properties and validation controls on the right.

scenarios.name: settings
scenarios.screen: The Questions tab shows the first of three sections, its three existing question cards, and the first question’s controls. The Settings tab is not selected, so response-policy switches and the closing-date field are not visible.
never: The response-policy settings pane is open on load.
Email collection or the one-response limit is shown as enabled.
A closing-date field is visible or filled in.

arrangements.text: The section tabs run above the first section’s question cards on the left and the selected question’s controls on the right.
The section tabs run above a wider question column on the left and a narrower control column on the right.
